training.labels: English Wiktionary usage examples and quotations with the meaning their editors attached them to, Kaikki.org extract of 2026-10-30
training.teacher: sign/Ettin-1B-WSD revision e6fc37a7e11fee91a600a0cd8e7423bcc639a1cc, soft labels at temperature 2 on those examples and on English Wikipedia paragraphs (wikimedia/wikipedia 20231101.en, file train-00001-of-00041, revision b04c8d1ceb2f5cd4588862100d08de323dccfbaa)
training.loss: 0.3 label cross-entropy (label smoothing 0.1) + 0.7 x T^2 x KL to the teacher, T = 2; learning rate 5e-5 (cosine), batch 64, seed 42
training.steps: planned 3 epochs (8,715 steps); early stopping on development accuracy (patience 4 evaluations of 300 steps) ended it at step 4,200; this is the step-3,000 checkpoint (1.03 epochs), the best on development
